caption: The drawing features a large, dark-shaded, cylindrical mug with a prominent handle attached on the right side, set inside a lightly outlined rectangular box centered on the page. The mug’s body is wide, with a slightly flared base and a thick rim at the top, and it has a smooth vertical surface with a highlight running down the center. The handle is large, curving outward and downward before ending in a spiral curl near the lower right of the mug. At the upper left corner of the page, there is a smaller box containing two line drawings, one of a curving handle shape and the other a straight cylindrical form. At the lower right corner, another small box contains a simple line drawing of the mug’s outline viewed from the side, showing its proportions and profile. The composition is in graphite or pencil on a light, uncolored background, with the main mug shaded in dark gray tones to suggest gloss and volume, while the other elements are rendered in simple, light outlines.
title: Pewter Mug
